risks.risk: Display refresh rate is not 120Hz as claimed
risks.proof: Screenshot of display settings showing refresh rate, or a video showing smooth motion at 120Hz.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 60Hz display, which reduces value.

risks.risk: SSD is not genuine 512GB or is a slow SATA drive
risks.proof: CrystalDiskInfo screenshot showing drive type and actual capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it were a slower or smaller drive, reducing value.

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if in good condition, but risk of hidden damage reduces value.

risks.risk: Battery health is poor or non-functional
risks.proof: Battery report screenshot showing cycle count and health percentage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if battery is good, but may be dead or degraded.
